scope: Additive supplement to existing Master Specification, Decision Ledger and prototype amendments; not a replacement or reconstructed full ledger.
source: Explicit user approvals in the continuing project conversation.

decisions.decision: Build real accounts, cloud syncing and shared community data before hosting the external beta.
decisions.relationship: Phase transition after the local-first prototype, not a reversal of the approved prototype work.

decisions.decision: Use Supabase Free for development. No paid projects, branches, upgrades or domain purchase without explicit approval.
Google Drive is the primary automatic backup destination. Preserve database and application code independently.
decisions.implementation_status: Folder created previously. Unattended credentials, schedule, encryption, alerts and restore drill are not configured by the foundation migrations.
decisions.proposed_tuning: Nightly encrypted exports and approximately 30 days retention remain the proposed starting configuration, not a claim of a running backup job.

decisions.decision: Repository is private. Development changes use development/backend-foundation. Never commit credentials or personal database exports, regardless of visibility.
Keep the tested prototype look and feel and personal workflow. Backend changes do not silently replace its local data or publish its demo records.
Pressure/flow profiling minutiae remain deferred. Existing approved advanced-feature and history semantics remain recorded for later, not discarded.
Retain the requested double-click Mac launcher and Documents-folder updater for the next applicable local distribution.
decisions.implementation_status: Not implemented by the cloud database foundation.

decisions.decision: New passwords must have at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter (A-Z) and one allowed special character. No lowercase or digit requirement. Apply to account creation and password recovery; do not impose new creation rules when signing into an existing account.
decisions.relationship: Explicitly replaces the previously unapproved 12-character new-password form minimum. Email verification, private user data, and all other locked access decisions remain in force.
decisions.implementation_status: Owner test frontend changed and unit tests added. Supabase Auth project password length and required character settings must be checked for compatibility before real signup and recovery verification.

decisions.decision: After successful registration, show a dedicated, prominent Check your email to confirm your address screen with the submitted address, confirmation guidance, and an explicit return-to-sign-in action; do not rely solely on a transient notice.
decisions.relationship: Owner-approved signup UX refinement. Email verification and beta invitation requirements remain unchanged.
decisions.implementation_status: Dedicated view and unit checks committed; hosted deploy and manual email-path verification required.

implementation_constraints: Private beta access is denied until membership is established by a trusted server flow; user metadata cannot grant roles.
Raw notes and account identity are excluded from shared projections.
All-green status is computed in the database; style timing does not veto it.
Community projections remain pending until the trusted quality-verification pipeline is implemented. This is staged implementation, not a new user-facing manual-approval requirement.
Numeric bounds follow the prototype sanity guardrails; Basket Dose +/-1 g is advisory.
Future API/schema transitions require additional tests. The foundation does not yet implement signup UX, sync, clustering workers, backup scheduling or production restore.
